# uptimeify_im_team (Resource)

An Incident Management team. Needs Incident Management activated for the organization. Members, escalation tiers and schedules are separate resources. Import with the numeric id.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "uptimeify_im_team" "platform" {
  name     = "Platform"
  timezone = "Europe/Berlin"

  escalation_repeats            = 1
  escalation_repeats_stop_mode  = "acknowledged"
  engagement_report_enabled     = true
  engagement_report_day_of_week = 1
  engagement_report_time        = "08:30"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) 1 to 120 characters, without surrounding spaces.

### Optional

- `analytics_enabled` (Boolean) Default `false`.
- `engagement_report_day_of_week` (Number) ISO weekday 1 (Monday) to 7.
- `engagement_report_enabled` (Boolean) Default `false`.
- `engagement_report_time` (String) `HH:mm`.
- `escalation_repeats` (Number) How often the whole ladder repeats. Default `0`.
- `escalation_repeats_after_minutes` (Number) Minutes before a ladder repeat.
- `escalation_repeats_stop_mode` (String) `acknowledged` or `resolved`. Default `acknowledged`.
- `label_color` (String) Free-form label color, e.g. `#43B1AE`.
- `timezone` (String) IANA zone, default for new schedules of the team. Unset = organization default.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String)
- `id` (String) Numeric team id.
- `organization_id` (Number)

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# Numeric team id
terraform import uptimeify_im_team.platform 12
```
